shloka_text: ततो द्वादशमे वर्षे शत्रघ्नो रामपालिताम् । अयोध्यां चकमे गन्तुमल्पभृत्यबलानुगः ।। 7.71.1 ।।
transliteration: tato dvādaśame varṣe śatraghno rāmapālitām | ayodhyāṃ cakame gantumalpabhṛtyabalānugaḥ || 7.71.1 ||
translation: ततः then, द्वादशमे in the twelfth, वर्षे year, शत्रघ्नः Shatrughna, रामपालिताम् protected by Rama, अयोध्याम् Ayodhya, चकमे desired, गन्तुम् to go, अल्पभृत्यबलानुगः accompanied by a small retinue of servants and army.
explanation: Then, in the twelfth year, Shatrughna, accompanied by a small retinue of servants and army, desired to go to Ayodhya, which was protected by Rama.
comments: In the twelfth year Shatrughna sets out for Ayodhya and lodges at Valmiki's hermitage, where the sage praises his slaying of Lavana, which he had witnessed from Indra's assembly -- there Shatrughna hears the singing of Valmiki's composed poem recounting Rama's own deeds, and he and his men are amazed and moved to tears, yet he forbids them to question the sage out of mere curiosity.

shloka_text: ततो मन्त्रिपुरोगांश्च बलमुख्यान्निवर्त्य च । जगाम हयमुख्यैश्च रथानां च शतेन सः ।। 7.71.2 ।।
transliteration: tato mantripurogāṃśca balamukhyānnivartya ca | jagāma hayamukhyaiśca rathānāṃ ca śatena saḥ || 7.71.2 ||
translation: ततः then, मन्त्रिपुरोगांश्च and the chief ministers, बलमुख्यान्निवर्त्य having sent back the chief commanders, च and, जगाम went, हयमुख्यैश्च and with excellent horses, रथानाम् of chariots, च and, शतेन with a hundred, सः he.
explanation: Then, having sent back his chief ministers and military commanders, he proceeded with excellent horses and a hundred chariots.

shloka_text: स गत्वा गणितान्वासान्सप्ताष्टौ रघुनन्दनः । वाल्मीक्याश्रममागत्य वासं चक्रे महायशाः ।। 7.71.3 ।।
transliteration: sa gatvā gaṇitānvāsānsaptāṣṭau raghunandanaḥ | vālmīkyāśramamāgatya vāsaṃ cakre mahāyaśāḥ || 7.71.3 ||
translation: सः he, गत्वा having gone, गणितान्वासान् counted days of travel, सप्ताष्टौ seven or eight, रघुनन्दनः the delight of the Raghus, वाल्मीक्याश्रममागत्य having come to Valmiki's hermitage, वासम् stay, चक्रे made, महायशाः the greatly renowned.
explanation: Having traveled for seven or eight counted days, the greatly renowned Shatrughna, the delight of the Raghus, arrived at Valmiki's hermitage and made his stay there.

shloka_text: सो ऽभिवाद्य ततः पादौ वाल्मीकेः पुरुषर्षभः । पाद्यमर्ध्यं तथातिथ्यं जग्राह मुनिहस्ततः ।। 7.71.4 ।।
transliteration: so 'bhivādya tataḥ pādau vālmīkeḥ puruṣarṣabhaḥ | pādyamardhyaṃ tathātithyaṃ jagrāha munihastataḥ || 7.71.4 ||
translation: सः he, अभिवाद्य having saluted, ततः then, पादौ feet, वाल्मीकेः of Valmiki, पुरुषर्षभः the best among men, पाद्यम् water for washing feet, अर्ध्यम् water for respectful offering, तथातिथ्यम् and hospitality, जग्राह accepted, मुनिहस्ततः from the hand of the sage.
explanation: Then, the best among men, Shatrughna, having saluted Valmiki's feet, accepted the water for washing feet, the respectful offering, and the hospitality from the sage's hand.

shloka_text: बहुरूपाः सुमधुराः कथास्तत्र सहस्रशः । कथयामास स मुनिः शत्रुघ्नाय महात्मने ।। 7.71.5 ।।
transliteration: bahurūpāḥ sumadhurāḥ kathāstatra sahasraśaḥ | kathayāmāsa sa muniḥ śatrughnāya mahātmane || 7.71.5 ||
translation: बहुरूपाः of many forms, सुमधुराः very sweet, कथाः stories, तत्र there, सहस्रशः in thousands, कथयामास narrated, सः that, मुनिः sage, शत्रुघ्नाय to Shatrughna, महात्मने to the great-souled one.
explanation: That sage narrated thousands of stories, varied in form and very sweet, to the great-souled Shatrughna.

shloka_text: उवाच च मुनिर्वाक्यं लवणस्य वधाश्रितम् । सुदुष्करं कृतं कर्म लवणं निघ्नता त्वया ।। 7.71.6 ।।
transliteration: uvāca ca munirvākyaṃ lavaṇasya vadhāśritam | suduṣkaraṃ kṛtaṃ karma lavaṇaṃ nighnatā tvayā || 7.71.6 ||
translation: उवाच spoke, च and, मुनिः the sage, वाक्यम् words, लवणस्य of Lavana, वधाश्रितम् related to the killing, सुदुष्करम् very difficult, कृतम् done, कर्म deed, लवणम् Lavana, निघ्नता by one who killed, त्वया by you.
explanation: And the sage spoke words concerning the killing of Lavana, saying that the deed of killing Lavana, which you accomplished, was extremely arduous.

shloka_text: बहवः पार्थिवाः सौम्य हताः सबलवाहनाः । लवणेन महाबाहो युध्यमाना महाबलाः ।। 7.71.7 ।।
transliteration: bahavaḥ pārthivāḥ saumya hatāḥ sabalavāhanāḥ | lavaṇena mahābāho yudhyamānā mahābalāḥ || 7.71.7 ||
translation: बहवः many, पार्थिवाः kings, सौम्य O gentle one, हताः killed, सबलवाहनाः with their armies and vehicles, लवणेन by Lavana, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, युध्यमानाः fighting, महाबलाः very powerful.
explanation: O gentle and mighty-armed one, many very powerful kings, along with their armies and vehicles, were killed by Lavana while fighting him.

shloka_text: स त्वया निहतः पापो लीलया पुरुषर्षभ । जगतश्च भयं तत्र प्रशान्तं तव तेजसा ।। 7.71.8 ।।
transliteration: sa tvayā nihataḥ pāpo līlayā puruṣarṣabha | jagataśca bhayaṃ tatra praśāntaṃ tava tejasā || 7.71.8 ||
translation: सः that, त्वया by you, निहतः killed, पापः wicked one, लीलया with ease, पुरुषर्षभ O best among men, जगतः of the world, च and, भयम् fear, तत्र there, प्रशान्तम् pacified, तव your, तेजसा by valor.
explanation: O best among men, that wicked one was killed by you with ease, and the fear of the world was pacified by your valor.

shloka_text: रावणस्य वधो घोरो यत्नेन महता कृतः । इदं तु सुमहत्कर्म त्वया कृतमयत्नतः ।। 7.71.9 ।।
transliteration: rāvaṇasya vadho ghoro yatnena mahatā kṛtaḥ | idaṃ tu sumahatkarma tvayā kṛtamayatnataḥ || 7.71.9 ||
translation: रावणस्य of Ravana, वधः the killing, घोरः terrible, यत्नेन with effort, महता great, कृतः done, इदम् this, तु but, सुमहत्कर्म very great deed, त्वया by you, कृतम् done, अयत्नतः effortlessly.
explanation: The terrible killing of Ravana was accomplished with great effort, but this very great deed was done by you effortlessly.

shloka_text: प्रीतिश्चास्मिन्परा जाता देवानां लवणे हते । भूतानां चैव सर्वेषां जगतश्च प्रियं कृतम् ।। 7.71.10 ।।
transliteration: prītiścāsminparā jātā devānāṃ lavaṇe hate | bhūtānāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ jagataśca priyaṃ kṛtam || 7.71.10 ||
translation: प्रीतिः joy, च and, अस्मिन् in this matter, परा great, जाता arose, देवानां of the gods, लवणे Lavana, हते having been killed, भूतानां of beings, च and, एव indeed, सर्वेषां of all, जगतः of the world, च and, प्रियं good, कृतम् was done.
explanation: Upon Lavana's death, great joy arose among the gods and all beings, and good was done for the entire world.

shloka_text: तच्च युद्धं मया दृष्टं यथावत्पुरुषर्षभ । सभायां वासवस्याथ उपविष्टेन राघव ।। 7.71.11 ।।
transliteration: tacca yuddhaṃ mayā dṛṣṭaṃ yathāvatpuruṣarṣabha | sabhāyāṃ vāsavasyātha upaviṣṭena rāghava || 7.71.11 ||
translation: तत् that, च and, युद्धं battle, मया by me, दृष्टं was seen, यथावत् properly, पुरुषर्षभ O best among men, सभायां in the assembly, वासवस्य of Vasava (Indra), अथ then, उपविष्टेन by one seated, राघव O Raghava.
explanation: O best among men, O Raghava, that battle was seen by me exactly as it happened, while I was seated in the assembly of Indra.

shloka_text: ममापि परमा प्रीतिर्हृदि शत्रुघ्न वर्तते । उपाघ्रास्यामि ते मूर्ध्नि स्नेहस्यैषा परा गतिः ।। 7.71.12 ।।
transliteration: mamāpi paramā prītirhṛdi śatrughna vartate | upāghrāsyāmi te mūrdhni snehasyaiṣā parā gatiḥ || 7.71.12 ||
translation: मम my, अपि also, परमा supreme, प्रीतिः joy, हृदि in the heart, शत्रुघ्न O Shatrughna, वर्तते exists, उपाघ्रास्यामि I will smell/kiss, ते your, मूर्ध्नि on the head, स्नेहस्य of affection, एषा this, परा supreme, गतिः expression.
explanation: O Shatrughna, supreme joy also resides in my heart, and I will kiss your head, for this is the highest expression of affection.

shloka_text: इत्युक्त्वा मूर्ध्नि शत्रुघ्नमुपाघ्राय महामुनिः । आतिथ्यमकरोत्तस्य ये च तस्य पदानुगाः ।। 7.71.13 ।।
transliteration: ityuktvā mūrdhni śatrughnamupāghrāya mahāmuniḥ | ātithyamakarottasya ye ca tasya padānugāḥ || 7.71.13 ||
translation: इति thus, उक्त्वा having said, मूर्ध्नि on the head, शत्रुघ्नम् Shatrughna, उपाघ्राय having kissed, महामुनिः the great sage, आतिथ्यम् hospitality, अकरोत् offered, तस्य to him, ये who, च and, तस्य his, पदानुगाः followers.
explanation: Having thus spoken and kissed Shatrughna on the head, the great sage offered hospitality to him and his followers.

shloka_text: स भुक्तवान्नरश्रेष्ठो गीतमाधुर्यमुत्तमम् । शुश्राव रामचरितं तस्मिन्काले यथाकृमम् ।। 7.71.14 ।।
transliteration: sa bhuktavānnaraśreṣṭho gītamādhuryamuttamam | śuśrāva rāmacaritaṃ tasminkāle yathākṛmam || 7.71.14 ||
translation: सः he, भुक्तवान् having eaten, नरश्रेष्ठः the best among men, गीतमाधुर्यम् the sweetness of the song, उत्तमम् excellent, शुश्राव heard, रामचरितं the deeds of Rama, तस्मिन् in that, काले time, यथाकृमम् in due order.
explanation: After eating, the best among men, Shatrughna, heard the excellent sweetness of the song narrating the deeds of Rama, in due order at that time.

shloka_text: तन्त्रीलयसमायुक्तं त्रिस्थानकरणान्वितम् । संस्कृतं लक्षणोपेतं समतालसमन्वितम् । शुश्राव रामचरितं तस्मिन्काले पुरा कृतम् ।। 7.71.15 ।।
transliteration: tantrīlayasamāyuktaṃ tristhānakaraṇānvitam | saṃskṛtaṃ lakṣaṇopetaṃ samatālasamanvitam | śuśrāva rāmacaritaṃ tasminkāle purā kṛtam || 7.71.15 ||
translation: तन्त्रीलयसमायुक्तं endowed with the rhythm of string instruments, त्रिस्थानकरणान्वितम् accompanied by actions in three registers, संस्कृतं refined, लक्षणोपेतं endowed with characteristics, समतालसमन्वितम् endowed with perfect rhythm, शुश्राव he heard, रामचरितं the deeds of Rama, तस्मिन्काले at that time, पुरा previously, कृतम् composed.
explanation: At that time, he heard the previously composed deeds of Rama, which were endowed with the rhythm of string instruments, accompanied by actions in three registers, refined, characterized by rules, and perfectly rhythmic.

shloka_text: तान्यक्षराणि सत्यानि यथावृत्तानि पूर्वशः । श्रुत्वा पुरुषशार्दूलो विसञ्ज्ञो बाष्पलोचनः ।। 7.71.16 ।।
transliteration: tānyakṣarāṇi satyāni yathāvṛttāni pūrvaśaḥ | śrutvā puruṣaśārdūlo visañjño bāṣpalocanaḥ || 7.71.16 ||
translation: तानि those, अक्षराणि words, सत्यानि true, यथावृत्तानि as they happened, पूर्वशः formerly, श्रुत्वा having heard, पुरुषशार्दूलो the tiger among men (Rama), विसञ्ज्ञो bewildered, बाष्पलोचनः with tearful eyes.
explanation: Having heard those true words, which recounted events exactly as they had formerly happened, Rama, the tiger among men, became bewildered with tearful eyes.

shloka_text: स मुहूर्तमिवासञ्ज्ञो विनिःश्वस्य मुहुर्मुहुः । तस्मिन् गीते यथावृत्तं वर्तमानमिवाशृणोत् ।। 7.71.17 ।।
transliteration: sa muhūrtamivāsañjño viniḥśvasya muhurmuhuḥ | tasmin gīte yathāvṛttaṃ vartamānamivāśṛṇot || 7.71.17 ||
translation: स he, मुहूर्तमिवासञ्ज्ञो as if bewildered for a moment, विनिःश्वस्य having sighed, मुहुर्मुहुः again and again, तस्मिन् in that, गीते song, यथावृत्तं as it happened, वर्तमानमिवाशृणोत् he heard as if it were happening in the present.
explanation: For a moment, he remained as if bewildered, sighing repeatedly, and in that song, he heard the past events as if they were unfolding in the present.

shloka_text: पदानुगाश्च ये राज्ञस्तां श्रुत्वा गीतिसम्पदम् । अवाङ्मुखाश्च दीनाश्च ह्याश्चर्यमिति चाब्रुवन् ।। 7.71.18 ।।
transliteration: padānugāśca ye rājñastāṃ śrutvā gītisampadam | avāṅmukhāśca dīnāśca hyāścaryamiti cābruvan || 7.71.18 ||
translation: पदानुगाश्च and the followers, ये who, राज्ञः of the king, तां that, श्रुत्वा having heard, गीतिसम्पदम् excellent song, अवाङ्मुखाश्च and with downcast faces, दीनाश्च and distressed, हि indeed, आश्चर्यमिति "this is a wonder", च and, अब्रुवन् they said.
explanation: And the king's followers, having heard that excellent song, became downcast and distressed, exclaiming, "This is indeed a wonder!"

shloka_text: परस्परं च ये तत्र सैनिकाः सम्बभाषिरे । किमिदं क्व च वर्तामः किमेतत्स्वप्नदर्शनम् ।। 7.71.19 ।।
transliteration: parasparaṃ ca ye tatra sainikāḥ sambabhāṣire | kimidaṃ kva ca vartāmaḥ kimetatsvapnadarśanam || 7.71.19 ||
translation: परस्परं to each other, च and, ये who, तत्र there, सैनिकाः soldiers, सम्बभाषिरे spoke, किमिदं what is this, क्व where, च and, वर्तामः are we, किमेतत्स्वप्नदर्शनम् is this a dream vision.
explanation: And the soldiers present there spoke to each other, wondering, "What is this? Where are we? Is this a dream vision?"

shloka_text: अर्थो यो नः पुरा दृष्टस्तमाश्रमपदे पुनः । शृणुमः किमिदं स्वप्नो गीतबन्धं श्रियो भवेत् ।। 7.71.20 ।।
transliteration: artho yo naḥ purā dṛṣṭastamāśramapade punaḥ | śṛṇumaḥ kimidaṃ svapno gītabandhaṃ śriyo bhavet || 7.71.20 ||
translation: अर्थो a meaning/thing, यो which, नः by us, पुरा previously, दृष्टः was seen, तम् that, आश्रमपदे in the hermitage, पुनः again, शृणुमः we hear, किम् what, इदम् is this, स्वप्नः a dream, गीतबन्धं a song-composition, श्रियः of beauty/fortune, भवेत् it might be.
explanation: They wondered if what they were hearing in the hermitage, which seemed to be a previously seen event, was a dream or a beautiful song.

shloka_text: विस्मयं ते परं गत्वा शत्रुघ्नमिदमब्रुवन् । साधु पृच्छ नरश्रेष्ठ वाल्मीकिं मुनिपुङ्गवम् ।। 7.71.21 ।।
transliteration: vismayaṃ te paraṃ gatvā śatrughnamidamabruvan | sādhu pṛccha naraśreṣṭha vālmīkiṃ munipuṅgavam || 7.71.21 ||
translation: विस्मयं wonder, ते they, परं great, गत्वा having reached, शत्रुघ्नम् to Shatrughna, इदम् this, अब्रुवन् said, साधु properly, पृच्छ ask, नरश्रेष्ठ O best among men, वाल्मीकिं Valmiki, मुनिपुङ्गवम् the foremost among sages.
explanation: Filled with great astonishment, they said to Shatrughna, "O best among men, please properly ask Valmiki, the foremost among sages."

shloka_text: शत्रुघ्नस्त्वब्रवीत्सर्वान्कौतूहलसमन्वितान् । सैनिका न क्षमो ऽस्माकं परिप्रष्टुमिहेदृशः ।। 7.71.22 ।।
transliteration: śatrughnastvabravītsarvānkautūhalasamanvitān | sainikā na kṣamo 'smākaṃ paripraṣṭumihedṛśaḥ || 7.71.22 ||
translation: शत्रुघ्नः Shatrughna, तु but, अब्रवीत् said, सर्वान् to all, कौतूहलसमन्वितान् filled with curiosity, सैनिकाः O soldiers, न not, क्षमः capable, अस्माकं for us, परिप्रष्टुम् to inquire, इह here, ईदृशः such (a thing).
explanation: But Shatrughna said to all the curious soldiers, "O soldiers, it is not proper for us to make such inquiries here."

shloka_text: आश्चर्याणि बहूनीह भवन्त्यस्याश्रमे मुनेः । न तु कौतूहलाद्युक्तमन्वेष्टुं तं महामुनिम् ।। 7.71.23 ।।
transliteration: āścaryāṇi bahūnīha bhavantyasyāśrame muneḥ | na tu kautūhalādyuktamanveṣṭuṃ taṃ mahāmunim || 7.71.23 ||
translation: आश्चर्याणि wonders, बहूनि many, इह here, भवन्ति occur, अस्य of this, आश्रमे in the hermitage, मुनेः of the sage, न not, तु but, कौतूहलात् out of curiosity, युक्तम् proper, अन्वेष्टुं to inquire, तं that, महामुनिम् great sage.
explanation: Many wonders occur here in this sage's hermitage, but it is not proper to question that great sage out of mere curiosity.

shloka_text: एवं तद्वाक्यमुक्त्वा च सैनिकान्रघुनन्दनः । अभिवाद्य महर्षिं तं स्वं निवेशं ययौ तदा ।। 7.71.24 ।।
transliteration: evaṃ tadvākyamuktvā ca sainikānraghunandanaḥ | abhivādya maharṣiṃ taṃ svaṃ niveśaṃ yayau tadā || 7.71.24 ||
translation: एवं thus, तत् that, वाक्यम् statement, उक्त्वा having said, च and, सैनिकान् to the soldiers, रघुनन्दनः Shatrughna, अभिवाद्य having saluted, महर्षिं the great sage, तं that, स्वं his own, निवेशं camp, ययौ went, तदा then.
explanation: Having thus spoken that statement to the soldiers, Shatrughna then saluted the great sage and returned to his own camp. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे एकसप्ततिमः सर्गः ।। 71 ।। Thus ends the seventy-first sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
